selection_policy: Pinned deterministic reserve candidates; actual headers/technical QC determine admitted unique intervals. No looping or replacement duplication to fill hours.
limitations: Downloads and technical QC are not human listening or evaluation admission.
The feature-only Generic Train corpus has no per-recording mapping, so complete independence from that historical pretrained feature file cannot be proven.
Seoul speech is natural topic-interview material; TV/radio/lecture and overlapping-speech percentages are not established.
Music has provider genre/vocal labels but not established Korean vocal-language coverage.
Speaker identity is unknown where the original corpus does not publish it; recording identity alone is not a guarantee of speaker independence.
FSD50K commercial-use contact notice and individual audio terms are both preserved.
All actual candidates remain evaluation-only and need representative human review; independent Final uses other reserved sources.
